task_completion.description: Launch Screaming Frog SEO Spider and enter the target URL.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screaming Frog GUI is visible with 'https://books.toscrape.com/' entered in the address bar.

task_completion.description: Initiate and complete the crawl of the website.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The progress bar shows 100% or the 'Start' button has toggled back from 'Pause/Resume', and the internal tab is populated with URLs.

task_completion.description: Export the Internal HTML data including response times to a CSV.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Export' dialog is visible, or the 'Internal' tab is filtered to 'HTML' before clicking export, with the file path pointing to '~/Documents/SEO/exports/'.

task_completion.description: Verify the CSV file exists in the correct directory with sufficient data.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file manager or terminal window shows a CSV file in /home/ga/Documents/SEO/exports/ containing at least 20 rows of data.

task_completion.description: Create a text report with the required metrics: total URLs, average TTFB, and top 5 slowest URLs.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor (like Gedit or Mousepad) shows a file containing specific numbers for total URLs, an average response time, and a list of 5 specific slow URLs.

task_completion.description: Include identified patterns and at least three optimization recommendations in the report.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The text report at ~/Documents/SEO/reports/ttfb_analysis.txt contains a section for 'Patterns' and a list of at least 3 distinct optimization suggestions.

integrity.description: The agent used the Screaming Frog GUI rather than simulating the crawl via CLI scripts.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show active mouse interaction with the Screaming Frog interface, menus, and export buttons.

integrity.description: The report data matches the data visible in the Screaming Frog application.
integrity.visual_evidence: The response times and URL counts in the final text report correspond to the values shown in the Screaming Frog 'Response Time' column and 'Summary' tab.

integrity.description: The agent used the specific file paths requested in the task description.
integrity.visual_evidence: Save dialogs or file explorer windows show the paths /home/ga/Documents/SEO/exports/ and /home/ga/Documents/SEO/reports/.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The target URL is https://books.toscrape.com/. The agent must export a CSV to /home/ga/Documents/SEO/exports/ with at least 20 rows. The final report must be at /home/ga/Documents/SEO/reports/ttfb_analysis.txt, be at least 400 characters long, and include: total URLs crawled, average response time, 5 slowest URLs, patterns of slowness, and 3+ optimization recommendations.
